caption: The drawing features three views of the same padlock: a front view, a side view, and a rear view. The padlock is rendered in various shades of gray and brown on a light beige background, giving it a metallic appearance. The front view, positioned at the upper left, shows a padlock shaped like a heraldic shield, with a sculpted face in relief resembling a stylized animal or mythological creature, possibly a lion, with prominent brows, pointed ears, and a keyhole incorporated into the mouth area. The lock's shackle is visible at the top and features some engraved details along its curve. The side view, located in the lower left, displays the depth and thickness of the object, highlighting the protruding face and layered construction. The rear view, situated at the lower right, presents a smooth, nearly circular central plate surrounded by decorative rivets or bolts and a scalloped border, with the shackle and lower hole also visible. The entire composition is drawn with careful shading to indicate volume and form, and the drawing is centered on an otherwise unmarked background.
title: Iron Lock
